answer: Sybil resistance holds when each new identity must post a refundable copper-weight stake that only vests after established peers attest its genuine work. A clone fleet can crowd the open meadow of names for free, yet every fake must lock fresh collateral and earn attestations one at a time, so the swarm stalls on a narrow ledge where committed capital, not raw headcount, decides who counts. Honest agents reclaim their bond; fakes forfeit it.
